Most over-the-counter (OTC) medications are not reviewed or approved by the FDA. However, they may be marketed if they comply with applicable regulations and policies. The FDA has not evaluated whether this product complies with such standards. Triticum is a gastrointestinal drug approved by the FDA for nutritional treatment. Common adverse reactions include hypersensitivity. Adult Indications and Dosage FDA-Labeled Indications and Dosage (Adult): Dissolve pellets under the tongue 3-4 times daily. Ages 12 and older: 10 pellets. Ages 2-11: 5 pellets. Under age 2: Consult a doctor. Diabetics and individuals intolerant to sucrose should consult a doctor before use. Do not use if allergic to any ingredient. Consult a doctor before use for serious conditions or if symptoms worsen or persist. If pregnant or nursing, consult a doctor before use. Do not use if the safety seal is broken or missing.
